rounds.endCondition: game ends after 9 rounds (round in which Home fields are harvested)

categories.label: Scoring marker on the Path of Prosperity
categories.labelVi: Vị trí marker trên Path of Prosperity
categories.hint: Space number reached by the scoring marker, before loan penalties.

categories.label: Loan cards taken
categories.hint: Each Loan moves the marker back 1 space at game end; loans are never repaid.

categories.label: Remaining cash (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Leftover cash cannot buy extra steps; only used to break ties.

categories.label: Vegetables in fields and Storehouse (2nd tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Rau còn lại trong ruộng và kho (hòa lần 2)
categories.hint: Vegetables in the Shop do not count.

tiebreakers.description: Most vegetables in fields and Storehouses
If still tied, the win is shared.

notes: family: track-position (running-track). Verified only against a secondary rules transcription (UltraBoardGames); official rulebook PDF not located (web search budget exhausted), so confidence is medium and needsReview=true. Marker advances in play by paying cash (1 for first step per round, then the number of each space entered). Regular/Casual customers carry no end-game penalty; vegetables in Shop are irrelevant.
